scoring_justification: Recomputing barriers and charges from raw DFT outputs in the verifier sandbox is infeasible due to heavy computational cost and dependency on DFT codes. Therefore, a result-level comparison against the paper's published values with appropriate tolerances is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold reference values for ethane C-H activation barriers (eV) and Pt charge sums (e) from the paper 'Promoter-poison partnership protects platinum performance in coked cluster catalysts'
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper main text and figures: Pt4 barrier 0.29 eV (Fig.2), Pt4C2 barrier 0.64 eV (Fig.2), Pt4GeC2 barrier 0.53 eV (Fig.4b); Pt charge sum in Pt4C2 -0.10 e (Fig.3a), Pt charge sum in Pt4GeC2 -0.50 e (Fig.3b). These are the lowest transition state energies reported relative to the global minimum of each composition.
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the paper text and figures
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual values reported in the paper; they serve as the reference for reproduction.

required.Pt4C2: object with keys ethane_barrier (eV) and Pt_charge_sum (e)
required.Pt4GeC2: object with keys ethane_barrier (eV) and Pt_charge_sum (e)

outputs.description: Reproduced ethane C–H activation barriers and Pt charge sums. The checker compares each numeric field against the paper‑reported values within hidden tolerances and verifies the ordering Pt4.ethane_barrier < Pt4C2.ethane_barrier and Pt4GeC2.ethane_barrier < Pt4C2.ethane_barrier.

output_contract.notes: The checker will also enforce the monotonic trend constraints. No gold values or tolerances are disclosed publicly.
